title: Joe Orton's Loot - 2017 production - Review
transcript: the watermill Theatre in Newberry celebrating his 50th anniversary and they've given us a great birthday present for this production of Joe Orton's lute when this play was first produced there was still censorship in the theatre now we're able to see the original uncensored version for the first time it's the story of two bank robbers who want to hide their stolen money in a coffin it exposes hypocrisy and corruption in the police the church it's very anti Authority and totally lacking in morality with the extra lines reinstated it's what was very funny play already is now hilarious one of the biggest benefits is that the coffin is now center stage and the corpse is played by a real person instead of a dummy and I have to say that Anna Rutan it's fantastic of where she keeps her body so limp when Joe's taken out of the coffin put upside down in a cupboard stripped naked wrapped up in a cloth she deserves an acting award all of her own that the whole cast are brilliant they're comic timing and delivery is pretty much perfect I give it five stars you
